integrity: All required equations and counts follow from the stated PBW commutator matrix and finite-field rank stratification. The accompanying checker independently rebuilds multiplication and ranks. No external independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The rank and class-size formulas are restricted to primitive-cube-root cubic quantum complete intersections over finite fields; they do not classify conjugacy representatives or characters. Finite coefficient-slice tests do not replace the universal algebraic proof. Equivalence with an unindexed prior computation remains a priority risk.
title: Centralizer ranks and conjugacy-class spectra of the cubic quantum complete-intersection algebra group
